title: Ducks Go Quack, Chickens Say Cluck - Onion Talks - Ep. 3
summary: An Onion Talks satire in which a faux animal behaviorist gives a pompous TED-style talk about ducks quacking and chickens clucking. It parodies the vacuous style of TED talks.
why: HN uses it as shorthand for the vapidness of TED talks and for content that says very little in a lot of words.
